default.description: Default capabilities for the Magician desktop app

orb-drag.description: Allows only the native Ambient Orb panel to begin a user-initiated window drag.

remote-unified-ui.description: Capabilities for pages loaded from the unified-ui Vite dev server at localhost or 127.0.0.1:5173. Lets the debug HUD route (/hud), debug draw overlay route (/draw-overlay), debug screen-region picker route (/screen-region-picker), contextual assist route (/contextual-assist), and bounded native Attention window call `invoke()` against Tauri commands defined in the desktop tray. Packaged overlay windows use the bundled desktop app protocol instead of this remote dev URL.
